items.raw_excerpt: Motorists in Finland have paid around 23 percent more per litre of petrol, and 40 percent more for diesel, compared to August 2025.
items.summary_en: Motorists in Finland are paying about 23 percent more per litre of petrol compared to August 2025. Diesel prices have jumped even more, rising around 40 percent over the same period.
items.summary_ko: 핀란드 운전자들은 휘발유 리터당 가격이 2025년 8월 대비 약 23% 올랐다. 디젤 가격은 같은 기간 약 40% 상승해 더 큰 폭으로 올랐다.
items.title_en: Fuel prices rise sharply in Finland in late summer
items.title_ko: 핀란드 여름 끝에 주유소 가격 급등
items.title_original: Finland sees late-summer spike in average fuel prices

items.raw_excerpt: State-owned oil supplier CPC Corp., Taiwan, will keep natural gas prices for domestic and industrial users unchanged in September but will increase them by 5.83 percent for companies that generate electricity, it said Monday.
items.summary_en: CPC Corp., Taiwan will keep natural gas prices the same for homes and factories in September. Power companies will see a 5.83% price increase. The state-owned supplier announced the decision on Monday.
items.summary_ko: 대만 국영 석유공급업체 CPC가 9월부터 가정용·산업용 천연가스 가격을 유지합니다. 전력생산 기업에는 5.83%의 인상이 적용됩니다. CPC는 월요일 이같이 발표했습니다.
items.title_en: Taiwan gas prices unchanged for consumers
items.title_original: Natural gas prices to consumers, industry to remain unchanged

items.raw_excerpt: Language classes can be expensive so if you're seeking to learn French or just improve your language skills, here are some of the free or affordable classes on offer.
items.summary_en: Learning a new language can be expensive, but there are free or low-cost options available in France. This guide helps residents find affordable classes to improve their skills.

items.raw_excerpt: Bihar and Jharkhand finalize Sone River water-sharing agreement, resolving a 25-year dispute and enhancing irrigation and drinking water access.
items.summary_en: Bihar and Jharkhand have signed an agreement to share water from the Sone River. The deal ends a dispute that lasted 25 years. It will improve irrigation and drinking water access in both states.

items.raw_excerpt: Santaco says women's safety must become a standard part of how the taxi industry operates.
items.summary_en: Santaco, South Africa's taxi association, is calling for women's safety to become a standard part of how the taxi industry operates. The group says taxi operators must prioritise the safety of women commuters across the country.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카 택시 협회 산타코가 택시업계에서 여성의 안전을 우선시해야 한다고 촉구했다. 이 단체는 택시 운영 전반에 걸쳐 여성 승객의 안전이 표준으로 자리잡아야 한다고 주장하고 있다.
items.title_en: Santaco pushes for women's safety standards in South African taxis

items.raw_excerpt: The Algarve remains among the most expensive areas of Portugal to rent a home, with asking rents averaging €22 per square metre per month.
items.summary_en: The Algarve remains one of the most expensive areas in Portugal to rent a home. Average asking rents now stand at 22 euros per square metre each month.

items.raw_excerpt: El delantero panameño de U. de Concepción anotó, se puso los guantes tras la expulsión de Jorge Broun.
items.summary_en: Cecilio Waterman, a Panamanian forward playing for Universidad de Concepcion in Chile, had to put on goalkeeper gloves after his team's keeper Jorge Broun was shown a red card. Waterman helped the team hold on and even joked afterward that opponents luckily did not kick the ball at him too much. The unusual moment came during a Chilean league match.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 콘셉시온 대학 소속 파나마국 공격수 세실리오 워터맨이 골키퍼 호르헤 브룬이 퇴장당한 뒤 빈자리를 채웠다. 그는 골키퍼 장갑을 끼고 남은 시간을 버텼고, 상대 선수들이 자신에게 공을 많이 차지 않아 다행이라고 농담을 남겼다. 칠레 프로축구 리그 경기에서 벌어진 기묘한 장면이다.
items.title_en: Panamanian striker steps in as goalkeeper after teammate sent off

items.raw_excerpt: Notting Hill Carnival, Europe's biggest street party, has celebrated its 60th year.
items.summary_en: Notting Hill Carnival, Europe's biggest street party, marked its 60th year with colourful parades and music. The annual event draws huge crowds to west London every August bank holiday weekend.

items.raw_excerpt: Ohne L-Tafel, mitten in der Nacht und direkt vor den Augen der Polizei: Ein Teenager liess es im Berner Mittelland richtig krachen.
items.summary_en: An 18-year-old moped learner drove at night without L-plates in the Bernese Mittelland. He performed wheelies right in front of a plainclothes police patrol. He was fined 610 Swiss francs.

items.raw_excerpt: Keralam Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala said he disagreed with Islamic scholar Kanthapuram A.P. Aboobacker Musliar's view that women should stay away from public life. He added that women have every right to participate actively in public life.
items.summary_en: Kerala Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala publicly disagreed with Islamic scholar Kanthapuram A.P. Aboobacker Musliar's opinion that women should stay away from public life. Chennithala stated that women have every right to participate actively in public life. The remarks sparked discussion about women's roles in Kerala society.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라 주 내무장관 라메시 체니탈라가 여성은 공적인 삶에서 멀리해야 한다는 이슬람 학자 무슬리아르의 주장에 공개적으로 반대했다. 체니탈라 장관은 여성이 공적인 삶에 적극적으로 참여할 모든 권리가 있다고 밝혔다. 이번 발언은 케랄라 사회에서 여성의 역할에 대한 논의를 촉발했다.
items.title_en: Kerala minister disagrees with scholar's view that women should stay home
